message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a large, central, yellow silhouette of a mosque dome and minaret. Inside this bright area is a crescent moon. Silhouetted figures stand before this light, casting long shadows downward onto a textured yellow surface. The group includes five people: from left to right, a person standing with hands down, an older individual with a walking stick, a small child pointing upward, a person in a wheelchair, and another standing figure.

Surrounding this central light is a dark teal forest of silhouetted, leafless trees. Two pairs of glowing yellow eyes are visible within the upper branches. The background transitions to a deep blue at the top. The word "TEMPO" is printed across the upper half in large, white, block letters. Other legible text includes "DI BAWAH LINDUNGAN MASJID" in bold white type, followed by a paragraph of smaller white text. In the corners, "Pabrik Undang-undang Bernama Baleg H.28" and "Ekonomi Sirkular Pesantren Hijau H.90" are visible. The bottom displays a barcode, QR code, and publication details including "31 MARET-6 APRIL 2024" and "RP 60.000".
